exceptions.relaxes: branch protection: required_approving_review_count 0 (policy 2), require_code_owner_reviews false, require_last_push_approval false - single developer
exceptions.closeWhen: A second reviewer exists (SYD-017); restore 2 approvals, code-owner and last-push approval.

exceptions.relaxes: branch protection: required_signatures false (policy true); the existing history stays unsigned and is never rewritten for signatures
exceptions.closeWhen: The owner has an SSH signing key registered on GitHub; new commits are signed and required_signatures is restored.

exceptions.relaxes: branch protection: required_linear_history false (policy true) - the history being pushed contains merge commits and PRs merge with merge commits (P-5)
exceptions.closeWhen: The owner chooses squash/rebase merges for PRs; restore required_linear_history.

exceptions.relaxes: ci.yml job Acceptance runs only when the repository variable ENABLE_ACCEPTANCE_JOB is true; it is not a required check
exceptions.closeWhen: PLAN-41 makes the acceptance job green, sets ENABLE_ACCEPTANCE_JOB=true and adds Acceptance to the required checks.

exceptions.relaxes: advisory-to-issue runs on workflow_dispatch only (no schedule) until the secret DEPENDABOT_ALERTS_TOKEN and the variable DEPENDABOT_ALERTS_TOKEN_CONFIGURED=true exist; GITHUB_TOKEN cannot read Dependabot alerts
exceptions.closeWhen: The owner creates the fine-grained PAT (Dependabot alerts: read, Issues: write), stores it as DEPENDABOT_ALERTS_TOKEN and sets DEPENDABOT_ALERTS_TOKEN_CONFIGURED=true.
